definition: a state of extreme ruin and misfortune
description: A young man in a stained apron stands in a small home kitchen while everything he is cooking goes wrong at once. Two slices of toast, black and smoking, pop up in the toaster in the foreground. He turns to a frying pan of vegetables on the gas hob and pushes them around with a spatula, wincing. Smoke drifts across the room. He opens the oven and a cloud of smoke rolls out around a roasting bird; he flaps a blue-striped tea towel at the smoke, coughing, the kitchen hazy behind him.

de.answer: Er schwenkt ein Geschirrtuch gegen den Rauch.
de.question: Was schwenkt der Mann?

es.answer: Está agitando un paño hacia el humo.
es.question: ¿Qué está agitando el hombre?
